_comment: Generic MCP gateway plugin. _comment keys are ignored by the JSON loader and keep this template valid JSON.
name: replace-with-gateway-integration-name

gateway._comment: Lifecycle metadata; the adapter records it but does not execute these commands.

fixture_registration._comment: How a later adapter slice will register the runner's MCP fixture.

client._comment: The externally started generic gateway's Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint and literal request headers.

deny_signals._comment: Set only documented deny signals for this integration; [0, 0] disables JSON-RPC code matching.
